svg.text: Main3 map. DRAFT revision 12 (as built in gray), 2026-09-29, Sable. Nothing here is decided.
400 x 300 m at 2.5 px per m. Origin south-west, x east, z north. Heights absolute. Walk times at 2.5 m/s. The loop is in DailyLoop.md.
FIRE: burning ridge 300 to 500 m WEST
day 1: not visible at all; first seen at the Ward on night 1
tower fire view W to SW, day 2 on if approved: glow and smoke over the far ridge, base hidden
wide tower view of the lot
Ward hidden by the rock outcrop

g.text: 109 m / 44 s, dead end, unsigned (the approved exception)
pale harsh light, spar with bulbs
tent on a 20 m granite stack
mouth in the ravine -6 m, not checked
chamber at -18 m; chant turns to bass
fence with gate: the map edge
tower sightline to a checked location
tower line blocked (Ward by the rock outcrop, cave by the rim)
Camp to the Ward at night: 226 m, 90 s. Camp to the office: 270 m. Giant tops at most 50 m absolute. Walk times are information, not a budget. Day 1: no fire, everything ordinary until the Ward.
Cultist cave, side view unfolded along the path (7 px per m along, 5 px per m up and down)
In plan the three ramp legs run side by side 5 m apart and the chamber lies east of the ramp: nothing is stacked.
ramp 48 m plus two 5 m turns, -6 to -18, 3.5 m tall; mouth to chamber about 73 m
One way in, one way out. Chases never enter.
